name: ainotate
description: Annotated screenshots for AI agents: capture a web page or desktop window, then draw numbered steps, arrows, boxes and labels placed off the content, with emails and tokens redacted automatically.

uvx.description: Run with uvx (requires uv); web capture needs Chromium once: uvx --from 'ainotate[all]' playwright install chromium

examples.title: Where is it
examples.description: Answer with an annotated screenshot instead of directions
examples.prompt: Show me where to switch Wikipedia to dark mode

examples.title: Bug report
examples.description: Mark the broken element in red and redact personal data
examples.prompt: Take a screenshot of the checkout page, box the wrong total in red and write a bug report
